 NETZSCH STA 449 F3 Jupiter ASC Simultaneous Thermal Analyzer 
 Details 
 Category: Equipment of Thermogravimetric and Calorimetric Research Centre 
 Hits: 5824
A robust, flexible, easy-to-operate instrument for determining caloric effects (transformation temperatures and enthalpies) and mass changes at the same time 
Easy for studying of melting & crystallization behavior, solid-solid transitions, polymorphism, degree of crystallinity, glass transitions, cross-linking reactions, oxidative stability, corrosion studies, temperature stability, decomposition, purity determination, specific heat, thermokinetics, compositional analysis.  
The high flexibility caused by the various sensors, the great variety of sample crucibles and the wide TGA-measuring range make the system applicable for analysis of all kinds of materials including also inhomogenous substances.
The balance system of the STA 449 F3 Jupiter offers high sample loads and measurement range as well as high resolution (1 μg) and low drift (in the microgram range over hours). Another outstanding feature of the balance section of the STA is its high accuracy. 
STA 449 F3 Jupiter – Specifications 
      • Temperature range – 20-1650°С. 
      • Temperature accuracy – 0.3°С. 
      • Heating and cooling rates – 0.001-50°C/min. 
      • Weighing range – 35 g. 
      • Resolution – 1 μg. 
      • Atmospheres: inert, oxidizing, reducing, static, dynamic. 
      • Vacuum-tight assembly – up to 10-2 mbar. 
      • Automatic sample changer (ASC) for up to 20 samples.
